description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar, sacrificing Cathodion to add {C}{C}.
Cathodion and Colfenor trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever.
Activate Ashnod's Altar, sacrificing Myr Retriever to add {C}{C}.
Myr Retriever triggers, returning Cathodion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Cathodion.
Repeat.
